name: pdf-translate
description: Read PDFs in VS Code, then select text, right-click and translate it in place with DeepL.

pdf-translate.targetLanguage.markdownDescription: Language to translate into, as a language code such as `vi`, `en` or `ja`.

pdf-translate.sourceLanguage.markdownDescription: Language of the PDF, or `auto` to detect it. Naming the source language explicitly is usually more accurate for documents that mix languages.

pdf-translate.cleanText.markdownDescription: Repair text taken from the PDF before translating it: rejoin lines broken mid-sentence, undo end-of-line hyphenation, and normalise ligatures, quotes and spacing. Turning this off sends the selection exactly as the PDF text layer reports it, which usually translates poorly.

pdf-translate.removeHeadersFooters.markdownDescription: While cleaning, also drop running headers, footers, page numbers and similar page furniture that falls inside a selection spanning a page break. Only applies when `#pdf-translate.cleanText#` is enabled.

pdf-translate.showOriginal.markdownDescription: Include the cleaned source text in the translation popup, in a collapsible section.

pdf-translate.timeout.markdownDescription: How long to wait for the translation backend, in milliseconds.

pdf-translate.default.cursor.markdownDescription: The default cursor tool for preview.

pdf-translate.default.scale.markdownDescription: The default zoom level for preview. Allowed values are `auto`, `page-actual`, `page-fit`, `page-width`, and 1-based scale values. (`1.0` means 100%)

pdf-translate.default.sidebar.markdownDescription: Show the sidebar on load. The default visibility of sidebar for preview.

pdf-translate.default.scrollMode.markdownDescription: The default scroll mode for preview.

pdf-translate.default.spreadMode.markdownDescription: The default spread mode for preview.
